title: Professional Planning Methods
description: Planning methods used by professional teams: brief frameworks, beat sheets, shot lists, risk registers, and reverse-planning from delivery.
summary: Professional planning methods are structured techniques that reduce production risk by defining outcomes, constraints, priorities, and decision ownership before creative execution.

rules: If no decision owner exists, appoint one before creative reviews continue.
